controls.tilt_hint: Adds the supported slat slider or tilt buttons when there is enough room. On smaller tiles, use the detail view. Your open/close selection stays unchanged.

tap.hold_light: Hold the tile for brightness and colour, as far as the light has them.

voice.title: Voice experiment
voice.privacy: OpenAI Realtime audio. The microphone stops on the configured idle timeout, Stop voice, or leaving this preview. Maximum 10 minutes. Voice controls Assist-exposed lights, switches and media players, including brightness and playback where supported. Current information uses OpenAI web search; text and sources are optional in the preview. Commands that start music end voice after the short acknowledgement.
voice.setup: Configure the selected voice provider in editor Settings to start voice.
voice.settings_description: Choose your voice provider. Each provider keeps its own API key and settings.
voice.key_server: Using an API key configured on the server
voice.key_private: Stored privately on Screen Manager. The saved key is never sent back to the editor.
voice.key_saved: Saved. Open Firmware preview to start voice; no restart needed.
voice.voice_hint: Used for new voice sessions. Stop and start voice to hear a change.
voice.voice_saved: Voice saved. New sessions will use this voice.
voice.openai_route: Direct OpenAI Realtime audio. No Home Assistant speech services are used.
voice.claude_route: Home Assistant recognises your speech, Claude answers, and Home Assistant reads the reply aloud.
voice.pipeline_hint: Uses only this assistant’s speech recognition, language and voice. Its conversation agent is skipped. Pause after speaking; the microphone listens again after the reply.
voice.pipeline_missing: In Home Assistant, configure a voice assistant with speech-to-text and text-to-speech (for example Whisper and Piper), then reopen Settings.
voice.claude_privacy: Claude receives recognised text and panel context. Audio goes through the selected Home Assistant speech services. Pause after speaking; listening resumes after the spoken reply. Up to 30 seconds per turn, 10 minutes per session. The microphone stops on the configured idle timeout, Stop voice, or leaving the preview. Claude web search supplies source links for current information. Commands that start music end voice after the short acknowledgement.
voice.idle_hint: Applies to both providers while waiting for you. Pauses during speech and processing. Minimum 1 second; default 5. Reopen the preview after saving.
voice.idle_saved: Timeout saved. Reopen the preview to use it.
voice.spotify_hint: Shared by OpenAI and Claude. Find tracks by title and artist; playback uses your Home Assistant Sonos or Spotify player. For Sonos, keep Spotify linked in the Sonos app. Use the Client ID and Client Secret of your Spotify developer app.
voice.spotify_missing: Optional: configure search to play a track by name. Existing playback controls work without it.
voice.spotify_market_hint: The two-letter code for your Spotify account country, such as NL or GB. Used to find tracks available there.
voice.spotify_saved: Saved. Start a new voice session. Spotify access is checked on the first search.
voice.spotify_replace_hint: Saved credentials are hidden. Enter both fields only to replace them.
voice.output_saved: Reply speaker saved. Reopen the preview to use it.
voice.output_hint: Choose where the assistant answers general questions. External replies pause microphone input. Music-start confirmations stay on the screen. Stop voice before changing this setting.

cover.buttons_tilt: Open, stop, close and slat tilt

voice_assistant.name: Enable voice assistant
voice_assistant.description: Optional voice control in the browser preview. Configure provider, API keys and reply speaker in the editor. Save and restart to apply.
